C0070.title: Unfair Competition Case Involving the 'Shengqianzhao' Price Comparison Plugin
C0070.summary: A typical data-related anti-unfair-competition case released by the Beijing Intellectual Property Court showed that Mofang Wangpin used the 'Shengqianzhao' browser plugin to alter Zhaopin page settings, insert price-comparison links, induce users to jump away, and read and store resume information. The first-instance court found unfair competition and awarded damages, and the appellate court dismissed the appeal and upheld the judgment.
